dedupe_keys.name: cihi indicator library and data tables canadian hospital emergency department long term care and health system indicators by province region and facility

description: The Indicator Library and data tables are the public face of Canada's national health data holdings, giving comparable measures of how hospitals, emergency departments, long-term care and other services perform across provinces, regions and individual facilities. They are published by the Canadian Institute for Health Information, which holds national databases such as the Discharge Abstract Database and the National Ambulatory Care Reporting System. The library defines more than 100 indicators, from average length of stay and hospital harm to wait times, emergency department visits, readmissions and spending, and the data tables page lists 240 workbooks drawn from holdings such as the Discharge Abstract Database and the National Ambulatory Care Reporting System. Indicator values are available as a free download from a customisable table, and the workbooks are free Excel downloads; record-level data need a separate request. Caveats: the all-indicator Excel file was unavailable on the day of reading, so indicator values must be exported from the interactive table, and definitions and coverage differ between data holdings. Simulation uses: setting arrival rates, lengths of stay and bed use in hospital and emergency department capacity models, and benchmarking regional service levels. Related records: the Quebec emergency department data (data-quebec-emergency-department-data) give hourly detail for one province, and AIHW MyHospitals (data-aihw-myhospitals-api) is the Australian counterpart.
name: CIHI Indicator Library and data tables: Canadian hospital, emergency department, long-term care and health system indicators by province, region and facility
schema_summary: Indicator Library: more than 100 indicators with definitions and methods (acute, ambulatory, emergency, home, long-term, palliative, primary care; access and wait times, efficiency, patient safety, health spending, workforce), values by province, region and facility with optional breakdowns (age, sex) and facility characteristics. Data tables: 240 workbooks from data holdings such as DAD, NACRS, CCRS, HMDB, NHEX, wait times, for example NACRS emergency department visits and lengths of stay by province and territory, and Hospital Harm results 2014-2015 to 2025-2026

sources.note: Definitions and methodologies for more than 100 CIHI indicators, from acute care, continuing care and rehabilitation to finance, spending and health human resources; filters by type of care (including emergency care), place of care and quality dimension; data for all indicators on the Download indicator data page

Latest data for all indicators at once; the all-indicator Excel file is currently unavailable because of a technical issue, and an interactive table can be customised (breakdowns, performance descriptors, facility characteristics) and downloaded

List of all CIHI data tables, 240 results; filters by data holding (CCRS, CJRR, CMDB, DAD, HMDB, NACRS, NHEX, NPDB, wait times and others); items published 24 September 2026 include risk-adjustment coefficients, Hospital Harm results 2014-2015 to 2025-2026 (XLSX) and NACRS emergency department visits and lengths of stay by province
Recently released indicators 24 September 2026: Hospital Harm, 30-day AMI and stroke in-hospital mortality, average length of hospital stay, hospital deaths following major surgery
